title: Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes (BVMC)
notes: The 331 Spanish texts (comedias like 'El gran teatro del mundo', 'El vellocino de oro', etc.) were harvested from the Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes, the major Spanish digital library run with the Universidad de Alicante; filenames follow BVMC URL slugs with year suffixes (e.g. el-gran-teatro-del-mundo-2010.txt). Site live. Open access but individual texts are copyrighted by BVMC (no blanket open licence). Origin verbatim: 'Biblioteca Cervantes'.
